agentGuide: Orders: GET /orders?status=processing&per_page=20 (id, status, total, billing, line_items); one: GET /orders/<id>; change: PUT /orders/<id> {"status": "completed"}; note: POST /orders/<id>/notes {"note": "..."}. Products: GET /products?search=<words>&per_page=20 (id, name, price, stock_quantity, stock_status); stock: PUT /products/<id> {"stock_quantity": 12}; create: POST /products {"name": "...", "regular_price": "9.90", "type": "simple"}. Customers: GET /customers?search=<email>; coupons: GET /coupons; reports: GET /reports/sales?period=month, GET /reports/top_sellers. Pagination comes in headers X-WP-Total and X-WP-TotalPages. Refunds are money: POST /orders/<id>/refunds asks for confirmation.
